name: Korg KRONOS Drum Kit
description: Korg KRONOS, KRONOS 2 and KRONOS 3: a drum kit, 128 notes of eight velocity zones each, by SysEx parameter change, read back from the current drum kit.

sources.title: KRONOS MIDI Implementation: Drum Kit, object version 3
sources.notes: Rows read by tools/profiles/korg/read-kronos-table.mjs from DrumKit.txt (sha256 f66128231627afba485fc3eee8861c9b21bdab8229e1622321d45090863b39e3) in KRONOS_MIDIimp.zip of 2025-07-24, https://www.korg.com/us/support/download/manual/0/988/5480/. Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/korg/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/korg/synths/, not this file.

Every row of DrumKit.txt with a parameter id is a parameter, named by its group and its name as printed, and sent by Drum Kit Parameter Change (function 53): F0 42 3g 68 53 VSP note PID and the value as 21 bits, two's complement, high byte first (*4), the table's VSP, note, PID columns giving the VSP, note, PID. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.
Repeated blocks: Note1 Zone1 DS: 8 blocks 34 bytes apart, the table printing the first in full and the others by their first and last rows, each checked.
Repeated blocks: Note128 High DS (offset 38124) is printed where the stride gives Note128 Zone1 DS; read as Note128 Zone1 DS.
Repeated blocks: Note1: 128 blocks 300 bytes apart, the table printing the first in full and the others by their first and last rows, each checked.

A drum kit: for each of its 128 notes, eight velocity zones of a drum sample, the splits between them and the note's common settings. The KRONOS takes drum kit parameters in Drum Kit mode ("Which parameters are currently available for editing depends on the instrument's mode"). The effects' own parameters, which depend on the effect type (Effect.txt), are not here.

A range whose first value is the larger (9D~63) is two's complement over its bytes, -99~+99. A choice is a row naming both of two values. The value column is 19 characters wide; a name it cuts short keeps its cut, with an ellipsis. Other value names are in each parameter's description.

Left out: 1024 settings (Note1 Zone1 DS Sample Bank UUID; Note1 Zone2 DS Sample Bank UUID; Note1 Zone3 DS Sample Bank UUID; Note1 Zone4 DS Sample Bank UUID; Note1 Zone5 DS Sample Bank UUID; Note1 Zone6 DS Sample Bank UUID; …): a 16-byte UUID, sent by Parameter Change (binary), function 44.

Pull: Current Object Dump Request (function 74) for object 04, the drum kit, answered by a Current Object Dump (function 75) carrying object version 3 and 38424 bytes in Korg's 8-in-7 packing (*3: 43914 bytes). 20352 parameters are read back at their rows' offsets and bits. A dump of any other length does not match.

Byte order: a value over whole bytes is read low byte first, and a field that runs on into the next byte has its low bits in the earlier one. The tables fill each byte from bit 0 upward (every effect's Bypass is bit 0 of its first byte, Wet/Dry bits 7~1 beside it), and a field crossing a byte continues upward in the next (an EXi engine's [LFO1] Start Phase at bits 7~5, then 3~0): the layout of a little-endian structure. A reading, not tried on an instrument.
The exclusive header carries the global MIDI channel as 3g; the profile's deviceId variable is that byte, 30H for channel 1.

Identity: the Device Inquiry reply (KRONOS_MIDI_Implementation.pdf) is printed F0 7E 0g 06 02 42 68 00 mm 00 vv ww xx 00 F7. Its 7th to 8th bytes, 68 00, are checked as printed, where the universal reply puts the family code; its 9th byte, mm, is one per model and is not checked: KRONOS/KRONOS2 61Keys 05H, KRONOS/KRONOS2 73Keys 0EH, KRONOS/KRONOS2 88Keys 17H, KRONOS3 61Keys 1DH, KRONOS3 73Keys 26H, KRONOS3 88Keys 2FH.
No preset recall: the implementation prints no banks for this object.
